findings.issue: «Зачем» contains a specific illustrative example — «Новый Mercedes-Benz 6x6» flagged as a duplicate of «5 Unsung Heroes» because both mention Porsche 911 GT2 and Red Line Club, with «5 Unsung Heroes» credited with 99 pairs — that appears nowhere in interview.yml or code-research.md (confirmed by grep across the whole feature folder and repo). The only 'Unsung' hit in the interview is a generic title-pattern reference («N Unsung…», used to describe roundup-title patterns in general), not a concrete flagged pair. No article named 'Mercedes-Benz 6x6' or a pair count of 99 exists in either source of truth. This directly undermines the section's own opening claim ('Правило измеримо неверное, и это померено на проде, а не предположено') by presenting an invented example as measured fact.
findings.location: Зачем, paragraph 2 ('Причина в том, что статьи...')
findings.fix: Remove the fabricated example or replace it with a verified one. The interview/code-research record real, citable cases instead: the hub articles «Last Car Culture Set for 2026» (56 pairs, 6 flags) and «Mooneyes Diorama» (40 pairs, 4 flags), or reuse the already-verified Boulevard example that appears later in 'Как должно работать'.

findings.issue: The claim «Шесть таких статей дали почти весь мусор» (six such round-up articles caused almost all the noise) has no matching figure in interview.yml or code-research.md. The notes name at most four hub-article titles with pair/flag counts (Unboxing: 10 Affordable Cars — 296 pairs; 11 New Collectibles — 28 pairs; Last Car Culture Set for 2026 — 56 pairs/6 flags; Mooneyes Diorama — 40 pairs/4 flags) and never state a total count of contributing articles.
findings.fix: Either cite the actually-named hub articles and their flag counts from the interview notes, or drop the unverified aggregate 'six articles' claim.

findings.issue: The accepted publish-timing side effect ('Публикации ускорятся... Оператор это принял.') drops the operator's stated rationale from the interview: 'очередь чаще пустая, чем переполненная (15.08 в ней было ноль), так что ускорение выхода — улучшение, а не давление на слоты.' Without it, the acceptance reads as a bare assertion rather than a reasoned decision.
findings.fix: Add the one-line rationale from the interview record so the acceptance is traceable to why, not just that.

findings.issue: Interview topic 'deploy_approach' (manual deploy to the Moscow Docker host, strictly outside the 10:00–20:00 MSK publish window because a restart resets the in-process daily schedule) was discussed and scored complete (85%) in the interview but is absent from user-spec.md entirely.
findings.location: missing — would belong in Ограничения or Как проверить
findings.fix: Add a line noting the deploy-timing constraint, or confirm explicitly that it is deferred to tech-spec (borderline in-scope for user-spec by this project's template, so low severity).

findings.issue: Several edge cases scored 'complete' in the interview are not mentioned anywhere in user-spec.md: empty/missing candidate title; `paragraphs=None`/empty list on the new article; malformed/non-dict candidate fingerprint (skipped silently, NOT routed through fail-open); a fingerprint with no `pairs` key (branch never runs). Only the 'line named nowhere' case is covered (Risk 3). Formal edge-case presence in the doc is met (Риски is non-empty with mitigations), so this does not fail the check, but the gap is real: a reader cannot tell from the spec that a malformed candidate fingerprint is handled differently from a genuine crash.
findings.location: missing — would belong in Риски or Ограничения
findings.fix: Add these as risk lines or fold into Ограничения, distinguishing 'malformed input is skipped silently' from 'a crash triggers fail-open [E016]' — the interview record treats these as two different code paths.

findings.issue: Acronym (RLC/STH) and Portuguese-title matching — scored complete (85%) in the interview and documented at length in code-research.md §3 (including a real asymmetry: uppercase-only acronyms under-match lowercase PT prose) — is never mentioned in user-spec.md. The rule's precision claims implicitly depend on this matching behavior working correctly across both languages.
findings.location: missing — would belong in Ограничения or Риски
findings.fix: Add a line noting the rule relies on the existing series-name matcher's behavior (including PT titles and case-sensitive acronyms), and note the known acronym-casing asymmetry as an accepted limitation.

findings.issue: Orphan flow: step 5 of 'Как должно работать' explicitly states the subject-rejected article is queued 'молча и без отсрочки' (no 24h defer), but no acceptance criterion verifies the 'без отсрочки' part specifically — AC4 only tests the terminal not-dupe/no-[E015] aspect. Symmetrically, step 4 ('declared in both → all as today: [E014] with buttons + 24h defer') has no AC re-confirming that the flagged case still gets the defer and buttons — exactly the behavior that ~26 existing integration test call sites currently pin and that this change risks breaking (per code-research §4.2–4.3).
findings.fix: Add two criteria: one asserting a subject-rejected broad pair publishes without the 24h defer, and one re-confirming a subject-confirmed broad pair still gets the defer + review buttons unchanged.

findings.issue: AC7 ('Каждое подавленное срабатывание пишется в лог — по нему можно посчитать, сколько шума срезано') is testable at its core (a log line exists per suppressed pair) but doesn't specify what the log line must contain. A log line that satisfies the letter of the criterion (e.g., just 'suppressed: 1') without identifying the pair/link would not actually let anyone 'count how much noise was cut' per-case as the criterion's own purpose clause promises.
findings.fix: Specify minimally what the suppressed-hit log line must contain (e.g., the two article links/titles and the rejected series name) so the criterion is verifiable against its stated purpose, not just its literal wording.

findings.issue: Ограничения states 'Правило set-overlap не трогаем... остаётся как есть,' while Технические решения / Risk 2 describe an explicit routing decision (Р1): subject-rejected broad pairs are now deliberately kept OUT of the backstop rather than falling through to it. On close reading these are consistent — the actual population of candidates that reaches the backstop is unchanged versus today (subject-rejected pairs never reached it before either, since today ANY shared broad key already terminates as a flag) — but the two sections sitting side by side without connecting them reads ambiguously on a first pass.
findings.location: Ограничения ('Правило set-overlap не трогаем') vs Технические решения / Риск 2
findings.fix: Add a clarifying clause that 'не трогаем' refers to the backstop's own logic/thresholds, not to what feeds it — to preempt the (incorrect) reading that this change alters the backstop's exposure.

covered: Measured false-flag rate: 31 soft flags / 22 with surviving fingerprints / 21 false / 1 real, over 1.5 months
Root cause: round-up articles produce a cartesian pair explosion, all 22 flags fired at 0-7% overlap
Cost beyond annoyance: a real duplicate (t-hunted Car Culture 21.07 vs autoevolution 18.07) was masked by the noise and both copies published
New rule definition: shared series must be declared in both articles' subject area (title, + first paragraph fallback for the new article; candidate limited to title only)
Terminal verdict for subject-rejected broad pairs / decision NOT to fall through to the set-overlap backstop (Р1)
Subject-area asymmetry caused by published_articles lacking a paragraphs column (Р2)
E014 ping text change — drop the 'порог автоблокировки 50%' phrase, name the matched line (Р3, corrected after code-research disproved the original premise)
Dedup log lines stop printing overlap% for the broad branch
Shadow log of suppressed broad-pair hits (Р4)
Fail-open behavior preserved ([E016] + publish on any crash)
Regression corpus: 31 real prod pairs (22 surviving fingerprints + 2 recovered via extract_fingerprint), target 3 real dupes flagged / ≤1 false remaining out of 21
Publish-timing side effect (~20 articles publish same-day instead of next-day), explicitly accepted by the operator
Risk: rule derived and validated on the same 22 pairs (overfitting risk), mitigated by the shadow log
Risk: a duplicate whose line is named nowhere (title or first paragraph) will pass silently — accepted
Risk: the first-paragraph backstop is inert on all currently available data (verified on 6 real t-hunted posts) — covered by a synthetic test only
Testing scope: unit tests always; no new integration tests, but ~26 existing call sites (_seed_published) need rewriting; no E2E
Post-deploy verification: 2-4 weeks of live [E014] monitoring + watch for an [E015] spike
missing: Specific edge cases: empty/missing candidate title; paragraphs=None/empty on the new article; malformed/non-dict candidate fingerprint (skipped silently, distinct from a fail-open crash); fingerprint with no `pairs` key
Acronym (RLC/STH) and Portuguese-title matching behavior, including the documented uppercase-only-acronym under-match asymmetry
Deploy approach: manual deploy to the Moscow Docker host, strictly outside the 10:00-20:00 MSK publish window
Confirmation that no manual user actions are required (keys/tokens untouched)
Operator's stated rationale for accepting the publish-timing side effect (queue is empty more often than full; 15.08 had zero pending)

summary: Спек структурно полон и в основном хорошо укоренён в измерениях — числа корпуса (31/22/21/1, плюс 2 восстановленных → 3 реальных/21 ложный) сходятся между «Зачем», «Критериями приёмки» и «Тестированием», критерии приёмки не используют неверифицируемых формулировок, шаблон и фронтматтер соблюдены. Но раздел «Зачем» содержит пример (Mercedes-Benz 6x6 / 5 Unsung Heroes / Porsche 911 GT2, 99 пар), не подтверждённый ни интервью, ни code-research — это блокирующая находка, требующая правки перед approval. Также стоит закрыть несколько edge-case тем из интервью, отсутствующих в спеке (пустые заголовки/абзацы, acronym/PT-matching), и добавить критерии, явно проверяющие отсрочку публикации в обоих сценариях (флаг/отклонение).
